name: Breaking the Keystone
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Opening the Stones of Binding loosened much of my confinement, but a lock still holds me chained.  It is the Keystone you see among this circle of stones.  And the key is held by one of my captors, the stone watcher Fozruk.

You must obtain that key, which the stone watchers call the Rod of Order, from Fozruk and use it to open the Keystone.

adventurer, you have done so much to aid me.  Just a little more...and my gratitude will shake the very foundations of the earth!
narrative.objectives: Find and kill Fozruk.  Bring the Rod of Order to the Keystone in the Arathi Highlands.
narrative.offerRewardText: You place the rod in the keystone. And a shudder is felt beneath you...
narrative.requestItemsText: The Keystone is charged with tremendous geomantic energy.

chain.subtitle: 8 quests from level 37 to 50, 25,800 XP in all.

quests.name: The Princess Trapped
quests.objectiveText: Gather 12 Motes of Myzrael, then bring them to the Iridescent Shards in Drywhisker Gorge.

quests.name: Stones of Binding
quests.objectiveText: Gather the Burning Key, the Cresting Key and the Thundering Key from the Stone of West Binding, the Stone of East Binding and the Stone of Outer Binding. Bring them to the Stone

quests.name: Myzrael's Allies
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Gerrig Bonegrip in the Forlorn Cavern of Ironforge.

quests.name: The Lost Fragments
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Torn Scroll Fragment, the Crumpled Scroll Fragment and the Singed Scroll Fragment to Theldurin the Lost.

quests.name: Summoning the Princess
quests.objectiveText: Go to the Shards of Myzrael, summon her and defeat her. Gather her Eldritch Shackles and bind them to the Shards of Myzrael.
